general_notes: Candidates fall into five recurring presentation types per state: (1) the painting inset in a flat dark border (character identical to target), (2) several near-identical in-app versions on a near-black round vignette, (3) a zoomed vignette crop that cuts off legs/feet, (4) a heavily blurred full-frame copy, (5) a 3D/CG re-creation. Within group (2) I could rarely tell versions apart at this resolution; the exceptions are joyful A (fewer embers) and depleted B (fainter smoke), scored slightly lower on C4. The vignette versions hide the depleted target's grey rectangular patch at lower right; I treated that as a neutral presentation difference. Motion: all eight sequences are very low-amplitude flicker loops with a static body; identity is fully stable and I saw no tearing, popping or ghosting at the given resolution, but six frames per loop cannot reveal timing/temporal smoothness, so A1 is uncertain. Expressiveness is weak for joyful and fierce in particular.
